results.title: What is the history of Sankirtan?
results.snippet: Although we can trace the idea of sankirtana back thousands of years, not until Sri Chaitanya was its full potential realized, for it was He who first demonstrated its universal attraction. For six years He traveled widely in India by foot, and wherever He went He introduced the practice of sankirtana.

results.title: What is the power of chanting Ram Naam?
results.snippet: “'Rāma', this two syllable Mantra, upon chanting even while walking, standing or sleeping, destroys all sins of Human beings in this world. The human being who chants 'Rāma' Naam becomes the most fortunate one and after getting all pleasures in this world at the end gets the supreme abode of Lord Hari (Shri Rāma).

results.title: What are the benefits of naam sankirtan?
results.snippet: Hari Naam Sankirtan offers benefits for the individual and society, including spiritual purification, inner peace, connection with the divine, and liberation from negative influences. Chanting the holy names of the Lord also attracts positive vibrations, fosters self-control, and creates a blissful atmosphere.
